description: Search TikTok by keyword. Returns videos by default; `type=user` returns accounts and `type=hashtag` returns hashtags. Use this for trend research and creator discovery when you do not already have a username. Costs 3 credits (13 for `type=hashtag`), cached or not; a failed call is refunded.

cursor.description: The `meta.next_cursor` from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

fresh.description: Skip the cache and fetch now. Charged normally. Not available on trial credits — buy any pack to unlock it.

limit.description: At most this many results, 1–30. A page can hold fewer while `next_cursor` is set: read until it is null.

type.description: What kind of result to return.

name: search_tiktok
title: Search TikTok
